comment.lv: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Dažādi </title><remarkFreeText><translation>Grozījums Nr. 104 bija atcelts.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>PPE grupa bija atsaukusi grozījumus Nr. 97, 108, 122 un 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hr: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Razno </title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amandman 104 je poništen.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Klub zastupnika PPE-a povukao je amandmane 97, 108, 122 i 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sk: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Iné </title><remarkFreeText><translation>PN 104 bol zrušený.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Skupina PPE stiahla PN 97, 108, 122 a 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.el: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Διάφορα </title><remarkFreeText><translation>Η τροπολογία 104 ακυρώνεται.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Η ομάδα PPE αποσύρει τις τροπολογίες 97, 108, 122 και 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Varie </title><remarkFreeText><translation>L'emendamento 104 è stato annullato.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Il gruppo PPE ha ritirato gli emendamenti 97, 108, 122 e 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.bg: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Разни </title><remarkFreeText><translation>Изменение 104 беше анулирано.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Групата PPE оттегли изменения 97, 108, 122 и 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.es: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Varios </title><remarkFreeText><translation>La enmienda 104 ha sido anulada.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>El Grupo PPE ha retirado las enmiendas 97, 108, 122 et 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.nl: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diversen </title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendement 104 is geannuleerd.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>De PPE‑Fractie heeft de amendementen 97, 108, 122 en 124 ingetrokken.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sv: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Övriga frågor </title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ändringsförslag 104a hade strukits.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>PPE-gruppen hade dragit tillbaka ändringsförslagen 97, 108, 122 och 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.mt: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Varji </title><remarkFreeText><translation>L-emenda 104 ġiet annullata.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Il-Grupp PPE irtira l-emendi 97, 108, 122, u 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diversos </title><remarkFreeText><translation>A alteração 104 foi anulada.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>O grupo PPE retirou as alterações 97, 108, 122 e 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.da: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diverse </title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ændringsforslag 104 var blevet annulleret.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>PPE-Gruppen havde trukket ændringsforslag 97, 108, 122 og 124 tilbage.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hu: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Egyéb </title><remarkFreeText><translation>A 104 a. módosítást törölték.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>A PPE képviselőcsoport visszavonta a 97., 108., 122. és 124. sz. módosításokat.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.et: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Muud küsimused </title><remarkFreeText><translation>Muudatusettepanek 104 tühistati.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Fraktsioon PPE võttis tagasi muudatusettepanekud 97, 108, 122 ja 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lt: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Įvairūs </title><remarkFreeText><translation>104a pakeitimas buvo panaikintas.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>PPE frakcija atsiėmė pasiūlymą dėl 97, 108, 122 ir 124 pakeitimo.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.de: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Verschiedenes </title><remarkFreeText><translation>Änderungsantrag 104 wurde annulliert.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Die PPE-Fraktion hat die Änderungsanträge 97, 108, 122 und 124 zurückgezogen.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.en: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Miscellaneous </title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendment 104 had been cancelled.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>The PPE Group had withdrawn Amendments 97,108,122 and 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Razno </title><remarkFreeText><translation>Predlog spremembe 104 je bil razveljavljen.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Skupina PPE je umaknila predloge sprememb 97, 108, 122 in 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.cs: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Různé </title><remarkFreeText><translation>Pn. 104 byl zrušen.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Skupina PPE vzala zpět pn. 97, 108, 122 a 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Divers </title><remarkFreeText><translation>L'amendement 104 a été annulé.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Le groupe PPE a retiré les amendements 97, 108, 122 et 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Aon ghnó eile </title><remarkFreeText><translation>Rinneadh Leasú 104 a chealú.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Rinne an Grúpa PPE na leasuithe 97, 108, 122 agus 124 a tharraingt siar.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ro: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diverse </title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendamentul 104 a fost anulat.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Grupul PPE a retras amendamentele 97, 108, 122 și 124.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
